user.title: Connect to Grocy & K-Ruoka
user.description: Enter your Grocy instance details and the K-Ruoka store ID. These settings are required to search for products and add them to Grocy.

data_description.grocy_url: Base URL of your Grocy instance, e.g. https://grocy.example.com
data_description.grocy_key: API key from Grocy → Manage API keys
data_description.store_id: K-group store ID, e.g. N110 for K-Supermarket Helsinki
data_description.location_id: Grocy location ID assigned to newly created products
data_description.quantity_unit_id: Grocy quantity unit ID assigned to newly created products

error.already_configured: This Grocy + store combination is already configured

abort.already_configured: This Grocy + store combination is already configured

init.title: Grocy Scraper Settings
init.description: Configure optional features such as the auto-discover interval and Gemini AI.

data_description.discover_interval: How often (in minutes) to scan the barcode queue for new barcodes
data_description.upload_images: Download and upload product images when creating new products
data_description.use_graphql: Use the faster GraphQL backend; disable only if you need the kr-api fallback
data_description.gemini_api_key: Google Gemini API key used by the Sort and Date action buttons
